# Test data

This directory holds the material used by the unit and component tests. The
bulky test data (certificates, UPP templates) is generated by
`scripts/extract-testdata.sh`; the generated files are committed, and
`.dockerignore` keeps them out of the container image.

Certificates are read directly from `sgp26/` by the SM-DP+/SM-DS. UPP templates
are not read at request time: `rsp42 admin upp import --dir testdata/upp` loads
them into the `upp_templates` database table (see `make seed`), and the example
CSV is loaded into `personalization` with `admin personalization import`. The
files here therefore serve as import/fixture sources only.

## Layout

The certificate tree under `sgp26/` uses a stable, normalized layout and file
naming so the project is insulated from GSMA's file-naming changes:

| Path | Content |
|---|---|
| `sgp26/CertificateIssuer/` | CI root certificate (DER/PEM) and private key |
| `sgp26/EUM/` | EUM certificate and private key |
| `sgp26/eUICC/` | eUICC certificate and private key |
| `sgp26/SM-DP+/DPauth/` | DP authentication certificate (DER) + key, plus the second identity |
| `sgp26/SM-DP+/DPpb/` | DP profile-binding certificate (DER) + key, plus the second identity |
| `sgp26/SM-DP+/DPtls/` | DP TLS certificate (PEM) + key, plus the second identity |
| `sgp26/SM-DS/DSauth/` | DS authentication certificate (DER) + key |
| `sgp26/SM-DS/DStls/` | DS TLS certificate (PEM) + key, plus the alternative identity |
| `upp/` | TS.48 test eUICC profiles (UPP / SAIP) |
| `personalization/profiles.csv` | Example personalization data |
| `vectors/` | Static protocol/crypto test vectors |

Canonical file names are `CERT_<role>_<curve>.der|.pem` and
`SK_<role>_<curve>.pem`, where `<curve>` is `NIST` or `BRP`.

## Provenance and licensing

- **SGP.26 certificates** come from the GSMA SGP.26 v3.0.2 (2026) test
  certificate distribution ("Valid Test Cases / Variant O"). They are test
  credentials intended for interoperability testing and carry no production
  trust. The DPtls/DStls certificates are valid until 2027-03; the signing
  certificates (DPauth, DPpb, DSauth) until 2027-07; the CI until 2059.
- **TS.48 UPP templates** are GSMA TCA test profiles used purely as test
  fixtures; no third-party implementation code is used at build time.
- These files are test-only and must never be used in production.

## Regenerating

Sources are passed explicitly (a local path or an http(s) URL to a directory,
`.zip` or `.tar.gz`):

```sh
./scripts/extract-testdata.sh \
  --sgp26 <SGP.26 distribution> \
  --upp   <TS.48 UPP tree>
```

`make testdata` does this with public upstream defaults; override `SGP26_SRC` /
`UPP_SRC` for local material. The script is idempotent: it removes and recreates
`testdata/sgp26/` and `testdata/upp/`.
